products.title: Autivara Solar — Spinning Car Diffuser
products.body_html:
A solar-driven rotor spins the moment sunlight hits your dash, fanning fragrance through the cabin with zero batteries, zero cords, and nothing to plug in or charge.

  • Solar-powered rotor — no batteries, no charging
  • Secure fit on any air vent
  • Waterless — just a few drops of oil, no spills
  • Refillable scent core you can top up anytime
products.seo_title: Autivara Solar | Solar-Powered Spinning Car Diffuser
products.seo_description: A solar-driven rotor spins the moment sunlight hits your dash, fanning fragrance through your cabin — no batteries, no cords, nothing to charge.

products.title: Autivara Astronaut — Car Vent Diffuser
products.body_html:
The finely sculpted astronaut that started the whole line — a display-worthy figure that clips to your vent and turns plain airflow into your signature scent.

  • Detailed collectible figure, offered in several colorways

  • Waterless core — a few drops of oil, no water tank, no spills
  • Refillable, so you can swap scents whenever the mood changes
products.seo_title: Autivara Astronaut | Sculpted Car Vent Diffuser
products.seo_description: The finely sculpted astronaut that started the line — a display-worthy figure that clips to your vent and turns airflow into your signature scent.

products.title: Autivara Aviator — Bear Propeller Diffuser
products.body_html:
A precision pilot bear car diffuser whose propeller actually spins on your vent's airflow — the moving part, not just a sculpt, is what fans scent evenly through the cabin.

  • Waterless core — a few drops of oil, no spills
products.seo_description: A pilot bear car diffuser whose propeller actually spins on your vent's airflow, fanning scent through the cabin — with a magnetic top for mess-free refills.

products.title: Autivara Disc — Magnetic Vent Diffuser

products.seo_title: Autivara Disc | Machined Metal Magnetic Vent Diffuser
products.seo_description: A machined solid-metal disc that closes with a satisfying magnetic snap — the most understated, grown-up diffuser in the Autivara car line.

products.title: Autivara Cabin — Rechargeable Car Diffuser
